assessments.reasoning: The dated report names all-read-only formal parameters as the condition for first-class procedure values and expressly excludes any read-write or write-only formal. The preceding lines distinguish assigning a procedure from assigning its call result. The adjacent worked rationale distinguishes direct calls to procedures with a write formal from assignment of their procedure values.

limitations: The restriction concerns using a procedure itself as a value. Ordinary direct calls and procedure return values have separate rules.
